links.outcome: Accuracy of bibliographic references (authors, details, DOI) generated by chatbots, verified against databases
links.effect: 1947 references checked; best accuracy 51% (ChatGPT-4.1 with web search), Gemini 2.5 Pro 41%; common errors were wrong author names and erroneous DOIs.
links.quote: Across the 6 chatbots, ChatGPT-4.1 (with web search enabled) achieved the best accuracy, with a score of 51%, with Gemini 2.5 Pro being second at 41%.

links.outcome: Reference accuracy with versus without web search retrieval
links.effect: The 2 chatbot versions with web search performed better than the 4 without, though best accuracy was still only 51%.
links.quote: The 2 versions with a web search facility performed better than the 4 versions without.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLMs on clinical guideline referencing and compares versions with and without web search functionality (retrieval grounding).
